_note: Points and tie-break rules per competition. Only add a system whose rules have been checked against a cited source; a competition with no system shows no standings rather than borrowed T20 rules. Tie-breaker keys: points, wins, net_run_rate, wickets_per_ball. tie_resolution 'super_over' means a tied match is decided by the super-over result (Match.eliminator) and scored as a win/loss; 'shared' awards the tie points to both sides.

points_systems.name: IPL league stage
points_systems.notes: Teams level on points are separated by most league wins, then net run rate, then wickets taken per legal ball bowled.
